title: Climbing Stairs
summary: Count the distinct ways to reach the top when each move climbs one or two steps.
algorithmSteps: The ways to reach a step equal the sum of the ways to reach the previous two steps.
Track only those previous two values.
Advance the pair until reaching the requested step.

examples.explanation: The Fibonacci-style recurrence produces eight valid step sequences.

edgeCases: One step has one valid route.
Two steps have two valid routes.
The implementation rejects non-positive step counts.
